sources.name: Denver Parks & Recreation – Activities & Programs
sources.reason: The city of Denver's main page for recreation classes and when registration opens. It also covers MY Denver programs for Denver youth and DPS students. Registration opens at noon on set days each season.

sources.name: Denver Parks & Recreation – Youth Sports
sources.reason: Denver's city page for youth sports leagues each season, including fall youth sports, cheerleading and gymnastics.

sources.name: University of Denver Ritchie Center – Youth / Denver Recreation
sources.reason: University of Denver page for youth recreation and clubs, listed by quarter (fall, winter, spring) and year-round.

sources.name: i9 Sports – North Westminster youth sports programs
sources.reason: Youth sports leagues in Westminster (80031), listed by season with start and end dates and age groups. This is a private league operator, not an official city page.

sources.name: Denver Zoo Conservation Alliance – Things To Do
sources.reason: The zoo's official events list, with dates for seasonal events like Fall at DZCA and Zoo Lights. Good for planning family zoo trips through the year.

sources.name: Denver Botanic Gardens – Public Events
sources.reason: Official list of special events at the York Street and Chatfield Farms gardens, including Blossoms of Light and Trail of Lights. The site also gives the ticket on-sale dates.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Mile High Holidays Lights
sources.reason: One page listing Denver holiday light events with dates and costs, such as Hudson Holidays, Larimer Lights, Light the Lights, Zoo Lights and Blossoms of Light. Several free options.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Biggest 2026-27 Events in Denver
sources.reason: The city tourism office's month-by-month guide to big events in 2026-27, updated recently. Good for spotting festivals and family events months ahead.

sources.name: Colorado Ballet – Sensory Friendly Performances
sources.reason: Lists relaxed, sensory-friendly ballet performances that suit young children and families.

sources.name: Downtown Denver Partnership – Parade of Lights
sources.reason: Official page for the free yearly 9NEWS Parade of Lights in downtown Denver.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Athletics
sources.reason: The city's main page for adult sports leagues near home. It covers basketball, indoor soccer, pickleball, softball and volleyball, with links to register.

sources.name: Westminster Parks & Recreation on TeamSideline – Adult Indoor Soccer
sources.reason: Westminster's official league site, run by the city. It has adult league schedules and standings, and most sports can be registered online there.

sources.name: Westminster Sports Center – Adult Indoor Soccer
sources.reason: Indoor soccer leagues for adults that run through the winter at the Westminster Sports Center.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Volleyball
sources.reason: Adult volleyball leagues at City Park Recreation Center and the Westminster Sports Center.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Basketball
sources.reason: A men's basketball league on Wednesday evenings at West View Recreation Center.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Softball
sources.reason: Spring adult softball leagues. The page lists the captains' meeting and the week games start, and is likely to be updated for the 2027 season.

sources.name: Arvada Center – All Events
sources.reason: A nearby arts center with theatre, concerts, gallery exhibitions and talks. The calendar already shows dates into 2027.

sources.name: Arvada Center – 2026-2027 Theatre Season
sources.reason: Season subscriptions and the full list of shows for the 2026–27 theatre season.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Upcoming Exhibitions
sources.reason: Upcoming gallery exhibitions, plus opening receptions and round-table talks for adults.

sources.name: Front Range Community College – Westminster Campus
sources.reason: The local community college campus in Westminster. It hosts concerts and campus events, and FRCC also runs affordable Continuing Education classes for adults.

sources.name: FRCC – Class Schedule FAQs / Continuing Education
sources.reason: Explains how to search FRCC's class schedule, including affordable non-credit Continuing Education courses.

sources.name: Adams 12 Five Star Schools district calendar
sources.reason: The official district calendar. It lists no-school days, staff workdays, school dates by level, board meetings and community events, and it shows dates for the 2026-27 school year. Families in the Westminster/Thornton/Northglenn area can use it to plan.

sources.name: Adams County Events & Public Meetings
sources.reason: The official county calendar, updated often. It lists festivals, family events like the Sheriff's Office trunk-or-treat, info sessions and public meetings, with upcoming dates in late October 2026.

sources.name: Adams County Parks, Open Space & Cultural Arts – Special Events
sources.reason: Lists the county's yearly community events at Riverdale Regional Park: Pride, Stars & Stripes on July 3, the County Fair, Festival Latino, Welby Days and the Colorado Dragon Boat Regatta & Night Market, which may interest Asian-American families. The 2027 fair dates are already posted.

sources.name: Adams County Health Department Events Calendar
sources.reason: Free community health events, including Baby Café pregnancy and breastfeeding support at the Westminster clinic, help signing up for health coverage, and workshops at Anythink libraries.

sources.name: Adams County Cultural Council Calendar
sources.reason: The meeting and grant schedule for the county arts council. It helps track arts funding cycles and local cultural programs. The 2026 schedule is posted, and the 2027 cycle is expected in spring.
